text:
tomo: Hi all — first day here. Quick q: where do I request service-account secrets for my dev env? I need access to a test workspace API key. Also, what's the expected rotation cadence? Thanks!

lina: Welcome aboard! :wave: Please use the secrets request form: https://go/redwood/onboard-secrets. Include repo, environment (dev/staging/prod), and a short justification. If this is prod, tag @eng-security for approvals.

tomo: Thanks — is there a small example template I should paste into the form?

lina: Yep, just paste something like: `repo: datasets-ingest
env: dev
why: local testing of ingest pipeline
requested_expiry: 30d` — or use the form fields.

raj: A couple of infra notes: our KMS keyring is `redwood-infra`. Default rotation for service keys is 90 days. For short-lived access, request a time-limited Vault token instead (ops will approve). Example CLI for token: `vault token create -policy=dev-read -ttl=24h`. For KMS-wrapped secrets we store the ciphertext in Vault and wrap with KMS.

tomo: Do I need membership in any group to get auto-approval on dev?

lina: If you're in the `redwood-devs` org group, dev requests auto-approve. Otherwise include a manager or repo owner as approver on the form. Prod requests require two approvers and an @eng-security review.

devex-bot: Reminder: New hire checklist step 4 — Vault access. If you don't submit the request within 48h a DevEx engineer will ping you here. https://go/redwood/onboard-checklist

tomo: OK submitted the form. Also: how do I decrypt or pull secrets locally — any CLI docs?

raj: Docs live at https://internal.docs.redwood.com/secrets/vault-cli. Short version: `brew install vault` then `vault login -method=oidc`. To read a kv secret: `vault kv get secret/data/redwood/dev/<name>`. For env loading: ```bash
export TOKEN=$(vault kv get -field=value secret/data/redwood/dev/service-key)
``` And please never check secrets into git.

lina: Rotation basics: if you rotate a key, update any deployments that consume it. Use the Console -> Secrets -> Apply to push updated values, or do a canary rollout of the service before full rollout. We recommend testing with a staging instance.

tomo: Great, thanks both — I'll follow up if anything breaks.

ashley: welcome tomo! happy to give a 15min walkthrough of Vault & KMS if you want — ping me and we can screenshare :slightly_smiling_face:

tomo: thanks @ashley, will take you up on that :thumbsup:

raj: Added tomo to `redwood-devs` group; you should see auto-approval for dev requests in ~5m.

tomo: Got the approval email — all set now, appreciate the help!
